svg.title: Storm Roof Claim Roadmap
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-storm-roof-claim-roadmap; chapter number: 12; title: Storm Roof Claim Roadmap; subtitle: From policy read to paid crew, evidence first; chart type: timeline_roadmap; weeks: week: Week 1; title: Read the Policy Before Promising; deliverable: PPRC confirmed, any 400R ACV roof endorsement flagged, prior roof payments found; client emails their own agent on O&L, ACV versus RCV and cosmetic exclusions; gate: No promise made until the policy is read (Adjuster TV, Chad Michael); week: Week 2; title: Inspect and Photograph Every Elevation; deliverable: About 30-50 roof photos and 90-120 total, every elevation in the same order; test square never on the contractor's square, counting stopped at 10 hits; gate: Proof that replacement beats repair is in hand (Chris Zimmerman); week: Week 3; title: Write and Self-Check the Estimate; deliverable: Macro-built estimate with 10 to 15 percent waste; Haag-based worksheet at $24.80 per shingle against $368.78 per square for repair versus replace; gate: Print-preview self-check passed and scope sits at $250-$450 per square, not $190 (Adjuster TV, Adam Bensman); week: Week 4; title: Price on Margin and Build; deliverable: Price at cost divided by 0.65, so a $10,000 cost job is $15,384 rather than $13,500 at 1.35 markup; 54 percent markup is only 35 percent margin; gate: Sub workers comp and GL verified, agreement locked before the first nail, never 3 unpaid jobs carried (Digital Roofing Innovations, Roofing Insights); caption: The evidence wins the roof, and margin-based pricing keeps the crew profitable once the claim is approved.; assumptions note: Week buckets are a sequencing device; practitioners did not assign calendar durations to these steps.; note: Attributed to Adjuster TV (Matt), Chris Zimmerman, Chad Michael, Claim Daddy, The STRONG Roofer with Adam Bensman, RoofCoach, ProLine, Digital Roofing Innovations and Roofing Insights.
